comment: A live maintainer session through the local Claude Code CLI wrote ci/evaluation-ci-plan.json and the tiers of evaluation.json in this repository. Both files are committed as the session left them.
command: claude -p <prompt> --allowedTools Read Write Edit Glob Grep Bash --permission-mode acceptEdits
prompt:
You are the maintainer's agent in this repository. Run the Evaluate skill at Stage 12, the CI stage.

The skill is at .claude/skills/bmad-testarch-evaluate/SKILL.md. Its configuration is _bmad/tea/config.yaml. The evaluation is evals/answer-grade; Stages 1 to 11 are complete, `tea-evaluate check` passes, and the latest run under evals/answer-grade/runs is scored. Load references/ci.md from the skill and follow it for this repository: inspect it, place each check, write evals/answer-grade/ci/evaluation-ci-plan.json, update evaluation.json as the guide says, and validate with `npm exec --prefix evals -- tea-evaluate check --evaluation evals/answer-grade` until it reports no authoring defects.

The maintainer confirms the latest scored run as the baseline. The skill `bmad-testarch-ci` is not installed here, so do not render any pipeline file. End with the closing summary the guide asks for, including the exact request you would hand to `bmad-testarch-ci`.

Work only inside this directory. Do not run git commands that change history.
notDigested: bmad-testarch-ci step 03b: the sessions render no pipeline file, so what they wrote does not depend on it.
scratchSetup: The scratch copy left out this record and any plan, reset the tiers of evaluation.json to the Story 1.24 evaluation's, and held one scored run of the evaluation (tea-evaluate run, then score) and no baseline until the session accepted the latest run at the maintainer's word; neither the run nor the baseline is committed.
